item: ТЗ-97 Q12 (строка 2) in this commit: «Собрать» on a non-demo paper used to call collect_synthetic in the UI thread and print a five-command refusal (reason synthetic_demo_only, 0 requests, nothing written). Now the window starts a _FollowWorker that runs the new door desktop_actions.follow_instrument, which parses ["--root", root, "follow", ticker, "--market", market] with cli._build_parser and calls the same cli.cmd_follow the terminal calls — no stage body is copied. cmd_follow grew two optional arguments (emit, cancel) and FOLLOW_CANCELLED = 130; its stdout is byte-identical, which tests/test_guide_truth.py proves by executing the GUIDE §1.1 block. The ticker is read from the store door (ticker_for_instrument), not split from the identifier, so a renamed paper is collected under its live ticker. The demo branch is untouched.
